verdict.rationale: Muse states you can 'inspect, edit and download' files in your VM 'including Muse's memory about you,' which implies some data export capability, and separately offers an activity/audit trail and training opt-out — but there is no explicit documented feature for exporting 'complete chat history' or full account data in a portable format (e.g., a GDPR-style data-export button). Missing for 10: explicit chat-history export feature, documented account-data export/download flow, and any independent/hands-on confirmation that exported data is complete.
